title: Unable to drag the Game window in the Godot Android Editor
body:
### Tested versions

Reproductioned in: Godot Engine 4.5, 4.4.
Not reproduction in: Godot Engine 4.3 or older

### System information

Android 11, Godot Engine 4.5, Mediatek Hello A22, PowerVR8300G, 2/32 GB, Tecno Spark Go 2022

### Issue description

Good day developers Godot Engine, you can figure out and fix the error in dragging a picture in a picture, on Godot Engine Editor Android?
Cause, I noticed this error myself in to "Game" mode, I wanted to drag this window that is on the side, where the back button, home, and the tab with running programs are, I want to move it to the other side, but it didn't work.I wanted to drag this window that is on the side, where the back button, home, and the tab with running programs are, I want to move it to the other side, but it didn't work, even if you check again, you still can't move the window to the other side.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0028cd77-c789-42d0-9cd3-f2dd7f59b54d

That's why I want you to fix this error because I found it and haven't paid attention yet, with problems with dragging picture in picture, because of this and please see this problem.
I will wait for you to fix it either in 4.5.1 or 4.6, if you will succeed, so good luck with your work on the fix, thank you.

### Steps to reproduce

To to reproduce, you just need to use any phone for your phone.
Further take absolutely any project in which you have.
Take any project on your devices Android, then click the Play button, and try dragging those places into the window where they appeared, moved to other places to the other side.
And the results of this, you simply won't be able to move the window.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

You can recreate any project, regardless of mine, because it happens on the editor herself.
